notes.title: New update (features & bug fixes)
notes.content:
Another small update

New features:

    Player lasers/projectiles now pass through friendly players (as well as Corby and other friendly bots). Should alleviate some of the get-out-of-my-way frustrations!
    Global leaderboard leader is now displayed in Arcade Mode player select screen.
    Player/controller select now works a bit differently, so Player1 isn't forced to use the first controller, and any player can use the keyboard/mouse



Bug fixes:

    Fixed extreme slowdown on some Windows10 machines, when gamepads were connected
    Online-multiplayer: Fixed camera issue when 2 players attempt to revive Corby at the same time
    Fixed teleporter problem on Level 7 when playing local co-op



If you're enjoying the game, don't forget to leave a review! If you have any feedback , be sure to post a message on the community page :)

notes.title: Dual Core next update progress report! (online multiplayer & new game mode)
notes.content:
So I've been quietly working away on future updates - I have the beginnings of a new game mode featuring procedurally generated levels (leave a comment if you have suggestions on the direction you'd like this to go!). In addition, I've made a lot of progress on implementing online multiplayer - it's a big task but maybe there will be a something to show - at least in beta form - within the next couple of weeks. 

Thanks to everyone who's supported the game - don't forget to leave a review!

notes.title: Wish list features for Dual Core
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I was wondering what features you'd be most interested in seeing added to Dual Core. Here are a few suggestions of what I *could* spend time adding. Obviously some of these are a bigger deal than others, and I can't do them all at once, but let me know what you think!


 Online multiplayer
 Procedurally generated levels - via a new game mode (it might be fun to do this as an ongoing beta, with your involvement over the direction it heads)
 Melee combat (as opposed to ranged combat) characters
 Mac & Linux versions
 new content ( enemies, weapons etc)
 other!


What would you like to see first? Let me know!

notes.title: Update: new upgradeable "Speed" stat, future melee characters
notes.content:
The latest update introduces a new stat on the upgrade screen: "Speed/Agility"

Upgrading this will improve your max speed, and acceleration. Have fun!  

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24757573/2ce0f7028aeb752cee4c4bda1ec084ea1f5a866e.png

I've also been working on the possibility of getting some melee based player characters in the game - it's something I wanted  in the release version but ran out of time. Any thoughts? Anything you'd like to see with melee combat?

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24757573/8df0a7aab3d54d81da655c9a948c252bb18d6b2c.gif  

Finally... if you're enjoying Dual Core, don't forget to tell your friends, and leave a review! It's hugely appreciated and helps get the game a little bit more visibility. Thanks so much!

notes.title: Another day another update
notes.content:
Again, mainly balancing and bug fixes:

Balancing:Made powerup drops more intelligent, so more skilled players (and/or hoarders!) don't  accumulate so many. 

Balancing: Adjusted damage on some enemies

Balancing: Adjusted difficulty slightly on level 5

Bug Fix: Fixed rare crash involving super laser.
Bug Fix: Fix for issue on level 7 where AI companions could become stuck.

Feature: High scores can now be viewed before playing arcade mode (not just after you die)

notes.title: Small bug fix update
notes.content:
I just uploaded small update that should fix a number of issues.

Bug fix: elevator levels sometimes won't finish, forcing you to restart them
Bug fix: inventory would sometimes display wrong icon
Bug fix: prevent issue where player 2 could finish the level without player 1, causing problems with Corby in the next level if you switch to single player mode.
Balancing: Arcade level 4 is now easier!
Balancing  tweaks to some bosses, enemy damage, health etc.

notes.title: Latest update:
notes.content:
Thanks to those who've bought the game! Be sure to leave a review if you're enjoying it!

The last couple of updates made some balancing changes, and some minor bug fixes.


Balancing: Tweaks to difficulty on later levels - it's now slightly harder late in the game.
Balancing: Changes to drop rates for powerups.
Balancing: chnages to help prevent loot exploit from enemy spawners.
Bug fix: wrong achievements being granted for arcade mode (off by one!)
Bug fix: fix rare issue where inventory would vanish, and become unusable.
Bug fix: Show UI hint to break ice on frozen companions - it wasn't always displayed previously.
